Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|P_{01370013}|^p) \leq C_01370013\) follows from the holomorphic Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via Laplace interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
